regulatory_descriptor: A Unit-Linked Non-Participating Individual Life Savings Insurance Plan
key_benefits: Maturity Benefit equal to the Fund Value as on the maturity date (market-linked, not guaranteed)

Death Benefit — higher of (Prevailing Sum Assured or Regular Premium Fund Value) plus higher of (Top-up Sum Assured or Top-up Premium Fund Value), subject to a minimum Guaranteed Death Benefit of 105% of Total Premiums Paid till date of death
Return of Mortality Charge (ROMC) added to the fund value at maturity (in-force, all due premiums paid; excludes surrendered/discontinued/paid-up)
Fund Booster at maturity (2% of average daily Regular Premium Fund Value over previous 3 years) for policy term 10 years or greater
Loyalty Additions at the end of the 10th, 15th and 20th policy years (all premiums paid up to date)
Family Benefit at maturity if a family member is an existing Bajaj Life policyholder
Choice of 4 investment portfolio strategies and a wide fund menu
Settlement Option — take Maturity or Death Benefit in instalments over up to 5 years with a 0.5% Return Enhancer (investment risk borne by policyholder/claimant during settlement)
riders_available: Bajaj Life Linked Accident Protection Rider II
Bajaj Life Linked New Critical Illness Benefit Rider

eligibility.policy_term: Not captured numerically from this brochure parse (eligibility table not recovered as text).
eligibility.premium_payment_term: Regular / Limited premium payment (non-participating, individual, unit-linked savings plan).
eligibility.note: Eligibility table did not survive the structural parse; numeric entry/maturity age and sum-assured limits are stated as 'per Board Approved Underwriting Policy (BAUP)'. Verify against the policy document.

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from receipt of the policy document (electronic or otherwise), except for policies with tenure under a year. Company may additionally repurchase units at the unit price on the date of cancellation; refund within 7 days.
key_terms.grace_period: 30 days for yearly/half-yearly/quarterly frequency; 15 days for monthly.
key_terms.suicide_clause: On death by suicide within 12 months of commencement or revival (whichever is later), nominee/beneficiary is entitled to the Fund Value as on the date of intimation of death; charges other than FMC/guarantee charge recovered after death are added back to the Fund Value. No other death exclusion.
key_terms.foreclosure_note: After 3 policy years, if Fund Value is lower than one Annualized Premium the policy is foreclosed and the Discontinuance/Surrender Value is paid.
key_terms.loan: No loan facility available under this plan.
key_terms.tax_note: Premium, Maturity Benefit, Death Benefit and Surrender Value eligible for tax benefits 'as per extant Income Tax Act, subject to provisions therein'; GST per prevailing tax laws — subject to change.

mandatory_disclosures_present: ULIP market-risk statement (investment subject to capital-market risk; policyholder solely responsible; NAV may go up or down; plan/fund name does not indicate quality or future returns)
Funds 'do not offer a guaranteed or assured return' disclosure

claims_marketing_must_support: Maturity Benefit is the Fund Value — a market-linked, non-guaranteed amount; any return figure must be shown as illustrative at 4% and 8% and labelled 'not guaranteed'.

The ONLY guaranteed element is the 105%-of-Total-Premiums-Paid floor on the Death Benefit; ROMC, Fund Booster and Loyalty Additions are conditional on the policy being in-force with all due premiums paid and are forfeited on surrender/discontinuance/paid-up.
Fund Booster at maturity is available ONLY for policy term of 10 years or greater — must be term-qualified.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT describe fund value, returns or maturity proceeds as 'guaranteed', 'assured' or 'fixed' — this is a unit-linked plan and the policyholder bears all investment/market risk.
Do NOT use 'bonus' language — the plan is non-participating; there are no bonuses.
Do NOT imply liquidity in the first 5 years — ULIP lock-in applies.
Do NOT present ROMC / Fund Booster / Loyalty Additions as unconditional — they require all due premiums paid and an in-force policy and are not paid on Top-up premiums.
Do NOT state tax benefits as assured — always carry the 'subject to prevailing tax laws' caveat.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Unit-Linked Non-Participating Individual Life Savings Insurance Plan'
ULIP market-risk disclosure: investment in ULIPs is subject to risks associated with the capital markets; the policyholder is solely responsible for his/her investment decisions
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document / benefit illustration for full terms, charges and exclusions
